headline: The garden gets gallery frames
lede: GARDEN GUARD's tray cards are portrait plates now — each critter posed on orchard soil under its own dusk sky in a riveted wooden frame that gilds when you pick it — and the never-dry pick also exposed a site-wide production stall the board now tracks as #2335.

notes.text: Tray cards #2331: posed portraits replace the reused 30px icons — Squirrel hefts an acorn, Chili smokes, Pumpkin loads the sling; frames breathe on the sim clock and turn gold on selection. Sim and layout untouched; gardencheck 55/55 with 8 new contract gates, proven red on a hand-mutant.

PROD STALL #2335: production keeps serving a pre-08:54 build despite three SUCCESS deployments (proof: the shipped string markers are absent from every referenced chunk, cache-busted, alias-fetched directly). Merged features are invisible until a dashboard fixes the alias flip.

Prod verification learned the hard way: every lazy game chunk is named index-*.js, so grepping the main bundle for game strings scans the wrong file — and cross-environment hashes don't match anyway. Marker-scan all chunks; that's the only portable proof.
The #2318 twin-stage fix held: this lane claimed its self-filed issue within seconds of creating it — no parallel-slot collision this shift.
